chunks.text: Abstract: Hymenoptera venom allergy is the most common cause of anaphylaxis in adults and the second-most frequent in children.

chunks.text: This review focuses on the current knowledge regarding diagnostics of Hymenoptera venom allergy.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0007
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The paper includes a brief description of the representatives of Hymenoptera order and the composition of their venoms.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0008
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Then, diagnostic tests for allergy to Hymenoptera venom are described.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0009
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Common diagnostic problems, especially double positivity in tests for IgE antibodies specific to honeybee and wasp venom, are also discussed.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0010
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Special attention is paid to the search for new diagnostic capabilities using modern methodologies.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0011
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Multidimensional molecular analysis offers an opportunity to characterize changes in body fluids associated with Hymenoptera venom allergy and yields a unique insight into the cell status.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0012
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Despite recent developments in the diagnostics of Hymenoptera venom allergy, new testing methodologies are still needed to answer questions and doubts we have.

#### 1.

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Introduction

Hymenoptera venom allergy is the most common cause of anaphylaxis in adults and the second-most frequent in children [1–3].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0015
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: After an insect sting, normal local reaction (NR), large local reaction (LLR), or a whole spectrum of general symptoms, including anaphylactic shock, may occur.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0016
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: According to European data, the frequency of systemic reactions ranges from 0.3 to 8.9% in adults and even up to 32% in beekeepers [2].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0017
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Systemic symptoms may affect the skin (itching, urticaria, angioedema), respiratory (stridor, dyspnea, cough, bronchial obstruction), cardiovascular (hypotension, tachycardia, arrhythmias, cardiac arrest), gastrointestinal (vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea), or even nervous system (dizziness, fear of death, fainting)—Figure 1 [4].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0018
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Fatal reactions are rare [5], but Hymenoptera stings cause 20% of cases of anaphylaxis-related fatalities [6].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0019
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Hymenoptera venom allergy is therefore a life-threatening allergy, and all patients who develop systemic symptoms after the sting require a detailed diagnosis.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0020
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Proper diagnostics allows for the appropriate management and implementation of venom immunotherapy (VIT) [7–9].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0021
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: VIT is currently the best form of treatment for venom allergies because it reduces the risk of subsequent severe reactions.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0022
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It is also a therapy that significantly improves the quality of life.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0023
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It should be emphasized that the proper qualification for VIT and its effectiveness depends on the correct diagnosis.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0024
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Today, we know better and have better diagnostic tools, thanks to which diagnostics and therapy can be individualized to the needs of a single patient [10].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0025
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Hymenoptera

1.1.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0031
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Hymenoptera

The basic element in the diagnosis of venom allergy is the identification of the insect that has stung the patient—Figure 2.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0032
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It is not only patients that have problems with distinguishing Hymenoptera insects, but sometimes also doctors [11,12].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0033
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Therefore, it is worth knowing the taxonomy of Hymenoptera insects and identifying their appearance and characteristics.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0034
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Most allergic reactions after stings in Europe are caused by insects of the Apidae and Vespidae families [13], and very rarely they are caused by Formicidaethese are often present in America (red fire ant), Australia (jumper ant), and Asia (Asian needle ant)—Figure 2 [14].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0035
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The Vespidae family includes Vespula spp.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0036
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: (Vespula vulgaris, Vespula germanica)—named wasps in and yellow jackets, and hornets (Vespa crabro) and paper wasps, (Polistes dominula) in Europe and the USA, respectively.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0037
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The most important representative of the Apidae family is the honeybee (Apis mellifera) and the less frequently stinging bumblebee (Bombus terrestris, B. agrarum, B. medics) [15].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0038
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The honeybee is the most aggressive towards humans.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0039
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: By contrast, wasps sting most often because they feed on sugars and are attracted to human food and drink, especially outdoors.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0040
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In terms of allergy, hornets can be treated like large wasps.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0041
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: They are scary due to their size.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0042
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, they are relatively non-aggressive insects—they sting only when threatened, e.g., when we breach their nest.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0043
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Bumblebees cause anaphylaxis mainly in gardeners since their role is to pollinate.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0044
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Particularly noteworthy is the species Vespa velutina.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0045
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: At the beginning of the first decade of the 21st century, it was imported from China and began to spread through Western Europe.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0046
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Contrary to media reports, scientific data from Europe show that this insect does not show more aggression towards humans than the other Vespidae, and the effects of its stings are similar to those of native species [16–18].

Hymenoptera Venoms


1.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0069

chunks.text: Matysiak, J.; Matuszewska, E.; Packi, K.; Klupczyńska-Gabryszak, A. Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy: State of the Art, Challenges, and Perspectives.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0070
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Biomedicines 2022, 10, 2170. https://doi.org/10.3390/biomedicines10092170.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0071
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Venoms of Hymenoptera are secreted by glands located in the abdominal cavity of insects.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0072
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Bees and other species use venom mainly for defense against predators.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0073
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Hence, Hymenoptera venoms are complex mixtures of different bioactive molecules that affect the intruder’s body.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0074
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: These odorless, transparent, and acidic liquids consist of biogenic amines, basic peptides and proteins—most of them have enzymatic activity [19].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0075
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Moreover, venoms contain sugars, phospholipids, pheromones, volatile compounds, and are also made up of about 80% water [20].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0076
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The best examined Hymenoptera venom so far is honeybee venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0077
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Although several hundred proteins and peptides contained in bee venom have already been identified, its full composition is still not characterized [21,22].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0078
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - 18 compounds of Apis mellifera venom have been reported to have biological activity [23].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0081
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Among these are 12 allergens that are responsible for the allergic reactions that occur after exposure to venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0082
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
In venoms of other Hymenoptera species, five allergens have been identified in venoms of Vespula vulgaris and Polistes dominula, four allergens in the venom of Solenopsis invicta, three allergens in the venom of Myrmecia pilosula, and two allergens in venoms of Vespa crabro and Bombus terrestris (according to www.allergen.com (accessed on
- 19 July 2022))—Figure 3.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0083
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
The major Apidae venom allergens include [24]:


- • Api m 1 is the phospholipase A2—the major allergen of honeybee venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0084
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Phospholipase A2 is also contained in Bombus spp.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0085
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: venoms (Bom p 1 and Bom t 1), but the protein sequence identities between Apis mellifera and Bombus spp.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0086
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: is approximately 52–53%.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0087
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Venoms of wasps contain phospholipase A1—Ves v 1 and Pol d 1, which differs in sequence and substrate specificity.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0088
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 2—hyaluronidase, the second major allergen of bee venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0089
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Due to the similarity structure of bee hyaluronidase and wasp hyaluronidase, this allergen is the main cause of cross-reactions of IgE antibodies against the venom of these insects.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0090
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Wasp hyaluronidase exists in 2 isoforms—Ves v 2.0101 and Ves v 2.0201.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0091
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 3—acid phosphatase is an enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of monoesters and anhydrides of phosphoric acid.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0092
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Together with the Api m 1 and Api m 2, it is considered as one of the most potent venom allergens.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0093
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 4—melittin is a minor allergen but the main component of bee venom, accounting for about half (45–50%) of its dry weight.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0094
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Melittin possesses strong hemolytic and


- antimicrobial properties.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0095
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Api m 3 and Api m 4 have been identified only in bee venom so far.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0096
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 5—dipeptidyl peptidase-IV and its analogues (Ves v 3 and Pol d 3) are present in wasp venom and the European paper wasp venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0097
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Ves v 3 and Pol d 3 are major allergens that show high cross-reactivity.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0098
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Antigen 5—an allergen found in the venom of almost all Vespoidea insects; Ves v 5 is found in the venom of yellow jackets; and Pol d 5 is found in the venom of paper wasps.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0099
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Its function is still unknown.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0100
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, it is known to be highly allergenic and responsible for cross-reactions.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0101
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Antigen 5 is a key element in CRD (componentresolved diagnostics) to distinguish between bee and wasp venom allergy [25].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0102
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Other Apidae venom allergens are minor allergens:
- • Api m 6—putative protease inhibitor.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0103
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It stands for only 1–2% of venom’s dry weight and is considered one of the weakest bee venom allergens.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0104
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 7—CUB (Clr/Cls, urchin EGF-like protein and bone morphogenic protein 1) serine protease, which shows high IgE-binding activity.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0105
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 8—carboxylesterase-6.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0106
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Bee venom contains less than 1% of this allergen, and its function is not yet fully elucidated.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0107
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 9—venom serine carboxypeptidase that belongs to the peptidase S10 family.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0108
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: There are no reports on the immunogenic properties of Api m 9.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0109
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 10—icarpin.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0110
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: This carbohydrate-rich protein is identified as a key allergen due to its importance not only in the diagnosis of bee venom allergy, but also in immunotherapy.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0111
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: VIT may be ineffective in patients allergic to Api m 10 due to being underrepresented in some therapeutic extracts [26].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0112
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 11—occurs in two isoforms: major royal jelly protein (MRJP) 8 (Api m 11.0101a), and MRJP9 (Api m 11.0201a).
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0113
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: MRJPs are a family of proteins identified only in the Apis spp.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0114
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: These proteins constitute about 90% of all royal jelly (RJ) proteins.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0115
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Human IgE antibodies recognize MRJP1 present in the sera of patients allergic to RJ, as well as to bee venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0116
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Api m 12—vitellogenin, 200 kDa peptide belonging to the vitellogenin family and cross-reactive to Ves v 6.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0117
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Among allergens of the Vespinae and Polistinae, we distinguish:
- • Ves v 1 and Pol d 1—phospholipase A1, a peptide with hemolytic activity.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0118
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: - • Ves v 2 and Pol d 2—hyaluronidase (in Vespinae isoforms Ves v 2.0101, Ves v 2.0201 exist) hydrolyzes hyaluronic acid.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0119

chunks.text: Their function is activating or inactivating substrates by cleaving dipeptides.

chunks.text:
Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy

Diagnostic tests for allergy to Hymenoptera venom should be performed in all patients with a history of systemic reaction following a Hymenoptera sting.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0126
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Tests should also be performed optionally in patients with a history of LLR if they have a particularly high risk of being re-stung, e.g., beekeepers, farmers etc., and have a significant reduction in quality of life because of this [27–29].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0127
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The diagnosis of Hymenoptera venom allergy in all the abovementioned cases yields qualification for VIT.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0128
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Immunotherapy is the most effective method of allergy treatment, during which the immune system develops an immunological tolerance to the allergen.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0129
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, it is a time-consuming method (3–5 years of therapy) and is associated with a risk of some side effects.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0130
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: That is why making the right diagnosis and starting VIT in a patient is so important.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0131
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Routine diagnostic tests include skin prick tests (SPTs) and venom sIgE level determinationFigure 4.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0132
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: To avoid false negative results, the mentioned tests should be performed at least 2–4 weeks after the sting (the so-called refractory period) [30].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0133
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: According to European guidelines, SPTs should be performed first.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0134
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: If their results are negative, the next step involves intradermal tests [30,31].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0135
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Intradermal tests have a much higher sensitivity than prick tests, which has been shown in clinical studies.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0136
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: SPTs identify 49% of patients with Hymenoptera venom allergy (HVA), whereas the combination of SPTs and intradermal tests made it possible to diagnose 94% of patients [32].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0137
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In Europe, standardized venoms of Apis mellifera, Vespula spp., Polistes spp.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0138
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: and Vespa crabro are available and can be used for skin tests.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0139
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Moreover, skin tests have been shown to be safe, even in patients with mastocytosis [33,34].

chunks.text: For this reason, they may be negative in patients only allergic to selected allergen proteins, e.g., Api m 10 [35].

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Tests should also be performed optionally in patients with a history of LLR if they have a particularly high risk of being re-stung, e.g., beekeepers, farmers etc., and have a significant reduction in quality of life because of this [27–29].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0150
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Determination of venom sIgE with whole venom extracts has lower sensitivity than skin tests—even 20% of patients with positive skin tests have negative in vitro tests to whole extracts of venoms.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0151
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Meanwhile, only 10% of patients with negative skin tests have positive venom sIgE.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0152
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: For this reason, it is currently recommended to perform skin tests and serological tests together [36].

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In addition, it was observed that the sensitivity of wasp venom sIgE ranges from 83% up to 97% and is lower than for honeybee venom sIgE—98–100% [37].

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Immunotherapy is the most effective method of allergy treatment, during which the immune system develops an immunological tolerance to the allergen.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0156
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, it is a time-consuming method (3–5 years of therapy) and is associated with a risk of some side effects.

chunks.text: That is why making the right diagnosis and starting VIT in a patient is so important.

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0182
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The much higher sensitivity of in vitro tests is obtained by performing a componentresolved diagnosis (CRD) [38–40].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0183
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: This innovative method is an increasingly better diagnostic tool in allergology today.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0184
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Thanks to CRD, sIgE against single allergenic proteins can be determined.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0185
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Using CRD, primary sensitization and cross-reactivity in patients with double positive results to whole extracts can be distinguished [41].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0186
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Very often (up to 75%), double sensitization to honeybee and yellow jacket venom is due to cross-reactive carbohydrate determinants—CCDs.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0187
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Currently, allergens for CRD testing are produced as recombinant allergens without the naturally occurring insect glycosylation (CCDs).
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0188
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: All abovementioned recombinant allergens are in CCD-free form.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0189
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Using the diagnostic capabilities of CRD, the sensitivity of tests for bee venom allergy reaches 94.4% [42].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0190
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: To achieve the sensitivity of diagnostic tests of 94–95% for allergy to honeybee venom, all six available allergen components—Api m 1–5 and Api 10—should be determined.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0191
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It was also found that 74% of patients had sIgE to more than one allergen of bee venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0192
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In wasp venom allergy, thanks to the combination of rVes v 5 and rVes v 1 determination, a sensitivity of up to 98% was observed [43].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0193
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: CRD tools facilitate the differentiation of cross-reactions between bee and wasp venom allergens [44] and are also more sensitive in patients with very low levels of sIgE to whole extracts [45].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0194
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In double sensitization, the CRD method is often helpful, but its possibilities are still limited and do not yield a resolve for all ambiguous clinical cases [46].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0195
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0196
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In the case of allergy to different wasp species (often between Vespula and Polistes), differential diagnosis is more complicated due to the independence from cross-reactions associated with CCDs [47,48].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0197
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: This problem certainly requires further research.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0198
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It may be beneficial to introduce further allergens into routine diagnostics—at least Pol d 1.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0199
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: All abovementioned recombinant allergens are in CCD-free form.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0200
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Using the diagnostic capabilities of CRD, the sensitivity of tests for bee venom allergy reaches 94.4% [42].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0201
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:

The possibilities offered by CRD contribute to the improvement not only of the diagnosis of venom allergy, but also better therapy—especially the appropriate qualification for

VIT.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0202
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: So far, there was no correlation found between diagnostic test results (including CRD tests) and the severity of the allergic reaction after a sting [49].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0203
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, some correlations between sIgE to bee venom allergens and the effectiveness of VIT was observed.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0204
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Sensitization to Api m 3, Api m 5, and Api m 10 is a risk factor for the failure of VIT because of insufficient content of these allergens in therapeutic extracts [26,50].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0205
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Besides, as mentioned above, CRD tests are helpful in patients with double sensitization and cross-reactions to different venoms.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0206
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0207
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Additional Tests

Among other additional diagnostic methods used in the diagnosis of Hymenoptera venom allergy, the following tests should be mentioned: basophil activation test (BAT), measurement of basal serum tryptase (BST) level, and sIgG4—Figure 4.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0208
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The BAT is recommended if all other diagnostic tests fail to make a proper diagnosis in patients with a history of systemic reactions to a sting [51].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0209
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In the BAT, the whole blood is stimulated with venom allergens, and the activation of basophils is measured by flow cytometry.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0210
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: This test can be performed in highly specialized laboratories, which limits its availability.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0211
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: A total of 67–81% of patients with negative skin tests and in vitro tests have a confirmed diagnosis of venom allergy by using the BAT [51,52].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0212
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The BAT is also recommended in the case of patients with a double positive result to Hymenoptera venoms and inconclusive results with recombinant allergens.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0213
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: BST levels should be marked in any case of systemic symptoms after a sting.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0214
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: An elevated BST shows a significantly greater risk of severe reactions to Hymenoptera stings.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0215
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: BST is also higher in patients with mastocytosis [53,54].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0216
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Venom sIgG4 arises in contact with an antigen and may play a protective role [55].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0217
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Significantly higher levels of bee venom sIgG4 were detected in beekeepers, who are regularly stung by bees and do not experience allergic reactions, despite positive venom sIgE determinations.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0218
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Increasing levels of sIgG4 are also observed during VIT.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0219
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Further research is required to find out whether they can be used as a marker in VIT.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0220
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The sting challenge test with a live insect is currently not recommended as a routine diagnostic method because of the high risk of severe reactions after the sting.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0221
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, the sting challenge test with a live insect can be used to evaluate the efficacy of venom immunotherapy, especially in patients with a high risk of re-sting [15,56].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0222
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: To summarize, it can be stated that modern diagnostics of Hymenoptera venom allergy are highly sensitive, especially with the use of CRD methods.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0223
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: By performing skin tests and in vitro tests together and, in special cases, additional tests, it is possible to diagnose most patients.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0224
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, it is still not possible to diagnose all patients who develop general symptoms following a sting.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0225
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: As shown, there are still difficulties in the case of double sensitization to venoms and making a decision about appropriate immunotherapy in this case is not easy.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0226
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Venom allergy is a potentially life-threatening allergy; therefore, making such a diagnosis has a significant impact on the patient’s quality of life.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0227
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: There are always questions about the likelihood of another anaphylactic reaction.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0228
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: While we have more and more improved diagnostic tools, it should be emphasized that the results of skin and serological tests do not correlate with the severity of symptoms after the sting.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0229
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Therefore, it is necessary to search for even better biomarkers of venom allergy, which can improve the diagnosis and effectiveness of immunotherapy.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0230
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0231
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Searching for New Diagnostic Capabilities of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy

Studies conducted to determine the protein–peptide profile in biological material obtained from allergic patients and healthy individuals (control group) have shown a relationship between the presence of a condition and the composition of body fluids/tissues.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0232
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Molecular differences between pathological and normal profiles can be used as biomarkers of disease processes and serve as a tool for correctly diagnosing and treating allergic conditions [57–61].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0233
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Proteins whose levels in the examined biological material correlate with the allergic disease have a regulatory function.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0234
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: According to the available literature, potential biomarkers include the hornsin, psoriasin, and calgranulin-B, as well as apolipoproteins, particularly apolipoprotein E9 and apolipoprotein H [57,59,60,62].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0235
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Acute phase proteins are the second crucial functional group of structures that are characteristic of allergic diseases.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0236
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Their concentrations change in response to inflammation.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0237
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: This group includes plasma albumin, transferrin, lactoferrin, fibrinogen (alpha chain), and orosomucoid (ORM-1 and ORM-2) [62–64].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0238
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, very few experimental reports focus on diagnosing Hymenoptera allergy using modern analytical platforms, such as liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0239
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Our research team has previously proposed a sophisticated methodology for searching for Hymenoptera venom allergy markers, based mainly on the mass spectrometry technique.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0240
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: For depicting alterations in protein–peptide patterns caused by bees’ and wasps’ venom, a highly sensitive and specific nano-liquid chromatography—matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (nanoLC-MALDI-TOF MS) method was utilized [65].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0241
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: As a result of the study, changes caused by venom administration have been observed in several compounds present in human serum.

chunks.text:
Diagnostic Challenge—Carbohydrate Determinants as the Cause of Cross-Reactivity in Patients Allergic to Hymenoptera Venom

Regarding allergy to Hymenoptera venom, a common diagnostic problem is the double positivity in tests for IgE antibodies specific to honeybee and wasp venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0286
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In such patients, the true dual sensitization and possible cross-reactivity of venom hyaluronidases and carbohydrate determinants should be taken into account [76].

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The distinction between double sensitization and cross-reactivity is critical in selecting an allergen for specific immunotherapy in patients who do not recognize the culprit insect [77,78].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0288
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Cross-reacting carbohydrate determinants (CCDs) are present on glycoproteins and are widespread in plants and insect venom [79].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0289
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Thus, anti-CCD IgE antibodies may reflect sensitization to plant or Hymenoptera venom allergens and are an important cause of a double positive results in vitro.

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: and carbohydrate determinants should be taken into account [76].

chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The distinction between double sensitization and cross-reactivity is critical in selecting an allergen for specific immunotherapy in patients who do not recognize the culprit insect [77,78].

Many of the allergens in bee and wasp venom are glycoproteins with an N-glycan structure [80].

chunks.text: Major allergens such as Api m 1, Api m 2, and Ves v 2 are glycosylated.

chunks.text: Both protein and CCD structures can act as epitopes for IgE antibodies.

chunks.text: Glycosylation (post-translational modification of protein) occurs in the endoplasmic reticulum [80].

chunks.text: Insect glycoproteins contain fucose attached to the core and MMF3F6 represents their typical structure - Figure 6 [81].

chunks.text: The main differences between insect and plant CCDs are the presence of xylose or α1,6fucose.

chunks.text: IgE antibodies directed against these glycan epitopes provide the basis for in vitro cross-reactivity of allergens from various sources.
