chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Horseradish peroxidase, ascorbate oxidase, and bromelain are the glycoproteins routinely used to identify IgE reactivity to CCD determinants [80].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0303
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Many of the allergens in bee and wasp venom are glycoproteins with an N-glycan structure [80].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0304
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Major allergens such as Api m 1, Api m 2, and Ves v 2 are glycosylated.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0305
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Both protein and CCD structures can act as epitopes for IgE antibodies.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0306
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Glycosylation (post-translational modification of protein) occurs in the endoplasmic reticulum [80].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0307
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Plant glycoproteins are composed of asparagine (N)-linked glycans carrying the core alpha1,3fucose and betha1,2-xylose and are represented by the two N-glycan structures: MUXF (bromelain) and MMXF (horseradish peroxidase).
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0308
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Insect glycoproteins contain fucose attached to the core and MMF3F6 represents their typical structure—Figure 6 [81].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0309
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The main differences between insect and plant CCDs are the presence of xylose or α1,6-fucose.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0310
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: IgE antibodies directed against these glycan epitopes provide the basis for in vitro crossreactivity of allergens from various sources.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0311
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Horseradish peroxidase, ascorbate oxidase, and bromelain are the glycoproteins routinely used to identify IgE reactivity to CCD determinants [80].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0312
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Figure 6.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0313
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Insect venom N-glycan structure.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0314
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Research shows that up to 59% of the patients allergic to Hymenoptera venom reveal positive results to more than one venom.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0315
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: More than the half of them show specific IgE antibodies to CCDs [37].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0316
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: According to data obtained by Kochuyt AM et al., IgE to CCD was detected in up to 72% of patients allergic to insects [82].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0317
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Renato Erzen et al.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0318
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: revealed true double sensitization in 37 patients (56.1%) and cross-reactivity in 29 of 66 participants with double positivity for wasp and bee venoms [76].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0319
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: They showed that levels of anti-CCD IgE antibodies (oilseed rape OSR pollen and MUXF3) in participants with cross-reactivity were significantly higher when compared to patients with a true double sensitization to wasp and bee venoms.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0320
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: These results confirm that IgE antibodies against carbohydrate determinants frequently cause double positivity in in vitro tests.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0321
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The clinical relevance of anti-CCD IgE antibodies is controversial; however, it is generally believed that they are clinically insignificant [83].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0322
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Van der Veen et al.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0323
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: examined patients with IgE antibodies to peanuts and found that participants without a clinical peanut allergy needed a much higher concentration of peanut extract to cause basophil degranulation than clinically allergic patients [84].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0324
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Similarly, Mari et al.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0325
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: determined that 82.7% of patients with IgE antibodies specific to plant glycans showed IgE binding to transgenic lactoferrin.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0326
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, compared to the main grass pollen allergen, the levels of lactoferrin needed for IgE biological activity were 5–6 orders of magnitude higher [85].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0327
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In beekeepers, CCD-specific IgE antibodies were detected in only 7.7% due to a tolerance to CCD.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0328
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Mertens et al.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0329
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: revealed the activity of anti-CCD IgE antibodies and suggested that they are clinically irrelevant in the case of insect venoms.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0330
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: A BAT for bee/wasp venom in participants with monosensitized Hymenoptera venom was positive for both venoms in 67% of patients with IgE antibodies to CCD.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0331
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: When using deglycosylated venom, the BAT was positive with only one insect venom [86].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0332
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: However, other studies emphasized the clinical importance of CCD [87,88].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0333
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Researchers observed the degranulation of basophils in patients allergic to zucchini, celery, and tomato after exposure to bromelain, while the deglycosylated tomato allergen Lyc e 2 has lost its ability to degranulate.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0334
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In addition, some participants had a positive oral challenge test with celery and zucchini; however, in vitro tests showed that these patients were only sensitized to carbohydrate determinants.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0335
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Recent analysis of the natural (glycosylated) and recombinant Api m 1 bee venom allergen has

shown that glycosylation increases allergenicity by presenting more epitopes.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0336
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Moreover, the glycosylated allergen had the ability to more strongly induce basophil activation [89].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0337
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It should be noted that the clinical irrelevance of anti-CCD antibodies is still under discussion.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0338
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It cannot be excluded that carbohydrate determinants cause clinical symptoms in some people.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0339
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The distinction between true double sensitivity to bee and wasp venom and crossreactivity remains a challenge and makes it difficult to identify the culprit.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0340
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Currently, component-resolved diagnostic (CRD) is used to distinguish between double sensitivity and cross-reactivity instead of an inhibition test.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0341
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: The use of advanced tools of CRD for CCD-free venom allergens enables the detailed characterization of sensitization profiles and the identification of the venom causing clinical symptoms [89,90].
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0342
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0343
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text:
Concluding Remarks

Despite developments in diagnostics of Hymenoptera venom allergy, new testing methodologies are still needed to answer questions and doubts we have.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0344
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Proteomics and metabolomics investigations, enabling analyses of hundreds of molecules in a sample, yield a unique insight into cell status.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0345
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Therefore, continuation of the performed omics studies can provide more complete information on patients’ health condition and lead to improved diagnostic capabilities.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0346
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: In clinical practice, there are still problems: first of all, is the distinction between asymptomatic sensitization and symptomatic venom allergy.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0347
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: There are many doubts in the case of cross-reactions and their differentiation with true double sensitization.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0348
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: Therefore, we still need the further development of already known diagnostic methods—including the introduction of new molecules using CRD, as well as completely new diagnostic methods, which may help solve the current diagnostic difficulties, and thus improve the patient’s treatment.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0349
chunks.doc_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers

chunks.text: It should be emphasized that only the correct diagnosis of allergy to Hymenoptera venom allows for the proper therapy of the patient, i.e., venom immunotherapy.
chunks.chunk_id: paper_PAPER - Matysiak et al. - 2022 - Diagnosis of Hymenoptera Venom Allergy State of the Art, Challenges, and Pers_chunk_0350
